Subject: real basketball player Nate Williams (ネイト・ウィリアムズ), whose official Chiba Jets profile portrait was inspected in this conversation. Draw him recognizably as a hand-painted black/ivory ink illustration, NOT photorealistic and NOT a pasted photo. Appearance: Black American man, athletic muscular shoulders, compact short tightly curled black afro with neatly tapered sides, high forehead, long oval angular face, defined cheekbones, straight broad nose, dark almond-shaped eyes under nearly straight brows, faint narrow moustache and a small neat chin goatee, mostly clean cheeks, medium-full lips. Plain unbranded sleeveless dark basketball jersey with ivory edging and plain shorts; no letters, names, numbers, sponsors or team marks on clothing.
Pose: dynamic low driving stance, torso leaning toward the center, three-quarter view with clear unobscured face. One orange basketball controlled in his right hand beside his hip, free left arm bent naturally. Frame from head to upper thighs so face, both hands and entire ball remain comfortably inside the canvas. Natural arm joints, normal hands and fingers. He is an illustrative subject selected at random from the article's named players; this is not a depiction of a real game and makes no claim about his current participation.
Layout: 5% safe margins. Text never overlaps face or hands. Right-side text left aligned, confidently spaced, extremely legible Japanese heavy gothic with subtle brush character. Make the two 10 numerals large and lime and 勝/敗 ivory, keeping one line. Other text ivory except small lime accent. Footer unobstructed and readable.
Text (verbatim; no additional text):
Top small brand: "バスケまとめ"

Constraints: only the text listed above. No player's name, individual performance, attendance, achievements or comeback claims. No actual-game recreation. No official/team/league logos, no official photo pixels, no photorealism, no watermarks, no added decorative text, no replicated wording/numbers/player from the style reference. Few bold elements, disciplined editorial design. Deliver one image only.

ONE PERMITTED CORRECTION
Edit image 1, the generated バスケまとめ thumbnail. Image 2 is ONLY the official profile photograph of real player Nate Williams for facial likeness reference. Do not paste or reproduce any photographic pixels; keep a clearly hand-drawn ink/brush illustration.

His moustache is faint and narrow; his chin has a small neatly trimmed goatee with mostly clean cheeks. Reduce the conspicuously thick pointed black beard and heavy moustache in image 1 to match the official portrait. Keep a naturally focused expression without adding deep furrows. Preserve the original illustrated sports pose, normal hands, orange basketball, plain unbranded jersey, and artistic ink hatching.
